verdict.rationale: xAI's docs explicitly document Remote MCP Tools letting Grok connect to external MCP servers to extend its capabilities with third-party or custom tools, confirmed via a live docs probe. This directly satisfies the story of plugging in MCP servers for tool use, though evidence lacks independent hands-on corroboration of real-world usage. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of remote MCP usage in practice, and details on multi-server management or auth scoping.
